steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Grab my hand.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hrh—Hah!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Alright!

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: We met on the train back there, but I never imagined you'd save my life here.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: How fortunate for you to be here to lend me a hand. Who knows how long I'd be stuck in here otherwise.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Thank you very, very much for your altruistic assistance, Madam Rosalind Tatyanovna Larina.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Well, wasn't much. Don't mention it.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You definitely don't look like a local, so I'm guessing you're a tourist going up the mountain?

spans.text: look like a local, so I'm guessing you're a tourist going up the mountain?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Precisely.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: So why didn't you follow the main road, instead of falling into a pitfall out here in the forest?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What were you gonna do if I didn't happen to pass by?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I was merely attracted by the scenic view, and didn't expect to run into a trap like this in the snow.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: If you hadn't happened by... perhaps I would have stayed here for a while longer. I'd calm down first before figuring out a way to climb out myself.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: But now I see how fortunate I am.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Madam Larina, are you going to continue your journey up the mountain?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Huh? Yeah, I am.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: We could travel together for a while, if you wouldn't mind.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I'd like to admire the view of Kjerag's mountains from the summit as well.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I don't mind. Let's go.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: We still have a long way to the top.

steps.name: Kjerag Elder
steps.text: That was...

steps.name: Kjerag Youth
steps.text: Riley!

steps.name: Kjerag Youth
steps.text: I just checked our traps and saw a pitfall collapsed. Thought we caught something!

steps.name: Kjerag Youth
steps.text: But when I took a look, there was nothing inside. Guessing it might have escaped.

steps.name: Kjerag Elder
steps.text: Did you see the man who passed by earlier? Doesn't he look like the guy Turiels asked us to look out for?

steps.name: Kjerag Youth
steps.text: You mean the one Degenbrecher asked us to find?

steps.name: Kjerag Elder
steps.text: All dressed in black, pretentious looking, wearing a hat and hiding his face. No doubt about it!

steps.name: Kjerag Elder
steps.text: Come! Let's hurry back and tell Degenbrecher!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hey, uh... say, I still don't know your name.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Aren't you guys pretty particular about uh, introducing yourselves when you first meet?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: An oversight on my part.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: You may call me John Smith. Or anything you prefer.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: John...?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: The name John Smith...

steps.name: 'John Smith'
steps.text: What do you think of it?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Sounds... right out of a spy movie I watched with the Doctor!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Yeah, that was definitely the name of the spy guy!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I remember he had a really pretty sidekick too, so John, you... Never mind, coming up to this make-out point all alone means you're definitely single.

steps.name: 'John Smith'
steps.text: A fascinating coincidence.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Right?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Alright, let's get back on track. I figure we still have a while to go before the summit.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I heard it gets colder the higher you go, and it gets harder to breathe too.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: So, you tired yet? Need a break?

steps.name: 'John Smith'
steps.text: Please, don't worry about me.

steps.name: 'John Smith'
steps.text: Do you need to rest, Madam Larina?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Nah, I'm good.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You've got some real stamina, huh, Mr. Spy?

steps.name: 'John Smith'
steps.text: ...Haha.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Seems like you really deceived him.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I fabricated no lies, Degenbrecher.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: There's no slipping your average falsehoods by a Trilby Asher collecting information for his Duke.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But I'm fully aware that these types usually know 'suspicion' best.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: 'The heir to the Paleroche Clan has secretly returned to the country' is a reality he first discovered by himself, so he'll believe it.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And will definitely be watching Rosalind Tatyanovna Larina.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Your guesses are always right.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: The girl's already on the mountain, and Ratatos has contacted Arctosz.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I hear tell the Trilby Asher is also on his way up.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: He's hiding from me.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: No matter.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Just make sure he remains focused on the girl.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It's time for you to move as well.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Fine, I'll treat it as after-meal exercise.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: However, are you sure the Doctor won't mind you letting the Trilby Asher close to the girl?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: He's a spy, not an assassin. What he's after is information, not a life.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Is that how you plan to explain it to the Doctor?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: To the Doctor, I shall offer my—apologies.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You certainly owe them.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: How I act is unimportant. Rather, I'm more curious—

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Degenbrecher, you remember the Doctor?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Sharp's a good opponent. Stronger than most of those clumsy knights.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: There's no harm in noting down someone who has the respect of a warrior like that and can also make you suffer.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You're curious about the Doctor?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You could put it that way.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Alright, the idle chatter stops here.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I'm going to work.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: URA—!!!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: We're finally here——!!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hoo. We must have climbed a few hours?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'm beat. No wonder everyone quits halfway. That was exhausting.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Though...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: The view up here is really pretty... isn't that Lake Silberneherze over there?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hahaha, the Kjeragandr statue looks smaller than my thumb from up here!

steps.name: 'John Smith'
steps.text: Lake Silberneherze freezes over in the winter, and resembles a pure and clear gemstone when viewed from this peak.

steps.name: 'John Smith'
steps.text: As such, the locals here believe the lake is a precious stone bestowed by Kjeragandr.

steps.name: 'John Smith'
steps.text: Truly a view you can only see from such a height.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: It does look like a gem.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Oh, you can even see the station over there!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Huh, there's actually plenty of railroads in Kjerag, but the trains all look like toys from here...

steps.name: 'John Smith'
steps.text: I wouldn't call this plenty for a country that's still developing.

steps.name: 'John Smith'
steps.text: It might seem like a lot, but that's because Lake Silberneherze and the Kjeragandr statue are here.

steps.name: 'John Smith'
steps.text: There might be more roads around Karlan currently, but the operating lines will all pass through and transfer here...

steps.name: 'John Smith'
steps.text: ...They will, won't they...?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hey, John, you still with us? I need a favor?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Can you help me see if there are two trees growing into each other around here?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: They should be old, with intertwining branches, and they look pretty strange too!

steps.name: 'John Smith'
steps.text: It would be my pleasure.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Appreciate it!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You know, John.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Aren't you curious why I'm looking for those trees?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Or what I'm doing up here on the mountain?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I mulled it over... and decided to handle things the old fashioned way.

steps.name: 'John Smith'
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: 'Fess up, and don't move!

steps.name: 'John Smith'
steps.text: What is the meaning of this, Madam Larina?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You're not supposed to say that line yet, I haven't even done anything to you.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Spit it out though. You've been following me for ages, just following. What are you after here?

steps.name: 'John Smith'
steps.text: I don't understand.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Quit playing dumb!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I don't remember telling you my name.

steps.name: 'John Smith'
steps.text: This is a misunderstanding.

steps.name: 'John Smith'
steps.text: You know the Viscount Harold Craigavon and I have history together, and it was he who told me your name.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You think I'm stupid?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I never told him my full name either.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: And you managed to climb up the summit without taking a single break. There's no way you could have fallen into a simple hunter's trap!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Even if you did, you could have just climbed out.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Anna and the girls always tell me to think before I act, but I have to say, sometimes there's no use in thinking too much either.

steps.name: 'John Smith'
steps.text: You are much more careful than I expected, Madam Larina.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: So you admit it?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: John Smith is probably a fake name too, right? Maybe... you really are a spy?

spans.text: John Smith is probably a fake name too, right? Maybe... you really

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: What if I said yes?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Then you'd be pretty bad at your job.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Cause even I could tell something was up.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Your accusation is absolutely correct.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: It's true. I have been quite careless, and life in Kjerag has made me so.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I have considerable freedom here, and there aren't many who pose a threat to me.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hah, look at you talk.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'm warning you, you'd better behave. And don't move an inch.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You're standing on the edge of a cliff, and there's nothing but snow under your feet.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I just have to stomp my feet to send you falling, and I can't promise I'll catch you if that happens.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Alright, Madam Larina. I'll come clean, yesterday...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Victorian scum!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Arctosz is here! You stay away from her!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Whoa! Wh-Where did you come from?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Ah-ah-ah-ah, wait! Watch your footfalls, the snow—

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Wahh—!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: R-Rosalind!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Grab my—

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: It's somewhat funny, but Arctosz is clearly charging towards me—

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Could Rosalind really have come here for something?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: No matter. He's coming, and I can only jump.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: ...The Black Knight.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: All rested up?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Not yet.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: That's not good.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You'll be less fun to fight.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Going straight into it?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Problem with that?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I'll get straight to my point too then.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: You convinced the Viscount that everything on the train was a misunderstanding. I was only half-convinced at the time.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: But now, I know that even the stately Black Knight tells lies.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: That only proves that you don't know me at all.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: There's still time to turn around and go down the mountain for a nice lunch.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I'm sorry, but I tend to throw myself fully into my work.
